name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Static-selection isolation build for 5wCal. V0.63's first short buzz followed by later long error buzz indicates the double tap reaches selection, but the blink/partial-draw path is unstable on hardware. Remove selection blinking entirely for this test, render the selected date as a permanent white cell with black digits during normal full-calendar drawing, and redraw the calendar once after selection. Keep the 400 ms tap window and 80 ms success buzz.
